load_model_from_pretrained: load a pretrained SAM audio model from a Hugging Face repo or local directory using _from_pretrained
get_model_device: get the device the BaseModel is running on by calling the device method
load_model_with_custom_config: load a pretrained model and override config values by passing model_kwargs to _from_pretrained
load_model_to_gpu: load a pretrained model onto the GPU by setting map_location to cuda in _from_pretrained
review_BaseModel_class: review the BaseModel class that extends torch.nn.Module and ModelHubMixin for Hugging Face integration
